fieldNotes.location: Confirmed large General Mills food plant at 1 Red Devil Rd, Hannibal MO (Nature Valley, Betty Crocker, Old El Paso, Progresso per Muddy River News). Roster geocode was GEOMETRIC_CENTER but landed within the industrial park; satellite confirmed the large plant; locked center 39.6818,-91.4144.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or gate identified at the property line. The plant access road runs from the public road past an electrical substation, over a creek bridge, and opens directly into the truck yard with no checkpoint structure - treated as open access. Flagged uncertain (Street View coverage on the private access road is partial).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth found. A small-structure cluster near 39.6803,-91.4137 where the bridge road enters the yard is a maintenance/materials storage area, not a staffed booth.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large drop-yard operation: multiple unmarked dirt/gravel lots NW and W of the plant filled with rows of parked drop trailers; well over 50, estimated 150 visible.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Main dock bank on the N/NW building face shows ~25-35 trailers backed in; estimated 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Could not clearly distinguish separate shipping vs receiving dock clusters from imagery; set false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved transition yard between the access bridge and the docks gives ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large main process building plus several attached/detached structures and a separate building cluster to the SW edge of the property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the north edge of the industrial park but no spur was observed entering the General Mills property itself.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~106 acres covering the plant, multiple drop yards, and employee parking.

citations.claim: MO econ-dev: GM expanding its Hannibal plant (since 1972, 1,000+ employees) making Nature Valley/Betty Crocker/Old El Paso/Progresso; new Old El Paso taco line + 35 jobs
GM late-2025 MO closures are St. Charles (pizza crust) + two Joplin pet-food sites, NOT Hannibal

verification.rationale: Hannibal was expanded Nov 2024 (taco line); the watch-listed late-2025 MO closures were St. Charles + Joplin, explicitly not Hannibal. Clears.
